name: nanobot
description: Lightweight personal AI agent with a web UI workbench.

install: set -a; . /etc/homemade/env; set +a; host=${HOMEMADE_URL#https://}; ws="wss://${host/-$HOMEMADE_VM_NAME-/-$HOMEMADE_VM_NAME-8765-}"; s=$(openssl rand -hex 16); mkdir -p ~/.nanobot; jq -n --arg s "$s" --arg w "$ws" '{channels:{websocket:{enabled:true,host:"127.0.0.1",port:8765,publicWsUrl:$w,tokenIssueSecret:$s}}}' > ~/.nanobot/config.json; chmod 600 ~/.nanobot/config.json; echo "WebUI password: $s" > ~/nanobot-password.txt; echo "Sign-in link: https://${host/-$HOMEMADE_VM_NAME-/-$HOMEMADE_VM_NAME-5173-}/#/?bootstrapSecret=$s" >> ~/nanobot-password.txt; chmod 600 ~/nanobot-password.txt
